First, I need to check the statement: "担 / 擔 is one of three characters that has a metric value measured in kg."

The table has six rows, each with a character. I need to see which characters have a metric value measured in kg (kilograms). Looking at the "metric value" column:

- lei4 (厘): 37.79931 mg (milligrams, not kg)
- fan1 (分): 377.9936375 mg (milligrams, not kg)
- cin4 (錢): 3.779936375 g (grams, not kg)
- loeng2 (兩): 37.79936375 g (grams, not kg)
- gan1 (斤): 604.78982 g (grams, not kg)
- daam3 (担 / 擔): 60.478982 kg (kilograms)

Only daam3 (担 / 擔) has a metric value in kg. The statement says it is "one of three characters" that has a metric value measured in kg. That would imply there are three characters with metric values in kg, but from the table, there's only one. So the statement is not supported.

I should double-check: Are there any other characters with kg? No, all others are in mg or g. So only one character has kg.

Therefore, the statement is false.
